components.name: Primary reading action
components.description: The principal cover link starts the book.
components.html: Empezar a leer
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:25px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 20px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--citron,#d9f65c);color:#142248;font:700 14px/1.55 var(--sans, 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .18s ease}.ds-primary:hover{background:#ebff9e}.ds-primary svg{transition:transform .2s ease}.ds-primary:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2345ec);outline-offset:5px;}.ds-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-primary svg{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary cover action
components.description: Quiet print-book link on the cobalt cover.
components.html: Comprar el libro

components.name: Search input
components.description: Borderless input with a semantic boundary above results.
components.css: .ds-search{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;background:var(--paper,#fafbff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d5dcef)}.ds-search-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}.ds-search input{min-width:0;padding:10px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#142248);caret-color:var(--accent,#2345ec);font:400 19px var(--sans, 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-soft,#505d78);opacity:1}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2345ec);outline-offset:-2px;border-radius:3px}.ds-search button{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;border:0;border-radius:3px;color:var(--ink-soft,#505d78);background:var(--paper,#fafbff);font:12px monospace;cursor:pointer}.ds-search button:hover{color:var(--ink,#142248);background:var(--accent-soft,#e3e9ff)}.ds-search button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2345ec);outline-offset:5px;}.ds-search button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Chapter navigation
components.description: Current chapter and adjacent section with distinct active color.
components.html: 1.2El tour del caballo1.3Las marchas del rey
components.css: .ds-nav{padding:16px;background:var(--paper-raised,#edf1fb)}.ds-nav a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;align-items:baseline;min-height:44px;padding:10px 8px;border-radius:0;color:var(--ink-soft,#505d78);font:450 13px/1.45 var(--sans, 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);text-decoration:none;transition:color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease}.ds-nav a>span:first-child{font-size:11px;font-weight:550;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--accent,#2345ec);background:var(--accent-soft,#e3e9ff)}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:#fafbff;background:#2345ec;font-weight:700}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]>span:first-child{color:var(--citron,#d9f65c)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2345ec);outline-offset:1px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

components.name: Chapter pagination
components.description: Raised-paper next section link at the end of an article.
components.css: .ds-pagination{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:154px;gap:20px;padding:24px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--paper-raised,#edf1fb);color:var(--ink,#142248);text-align:right;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .18s ease}.ds-pagination span{color:var(--ink-soft,#505d78);font:650 12px/1.4 var(--sans, 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-pagination strong{font:750 23px/1.25 var(--sans, 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);letter-spacing:-.02em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-pagination:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#e3e9ff)}.ds-pagination:hover strong{color:var(--accent,#2345ec)}.ds-pagination:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2345ec);outline-offset:-4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-pagination{transition:none}}

components.name: Reading completion toggle
components.description: Meaningful checkbox boundary and citron completed state.
components.css: .ds-read{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#8896b6);border-radius:0;color:var(--ink,#142248);background:var(--paper,#fafbff);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}.ds-read b{font:650 13px/1.4 var(--sans, 'Archivo', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-read>span{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#8896b6)}.ds-read:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#2345ec);background:var(--accent-soft,#e3e9ff)}.ds-read[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--citron,#d9f65c);border-color:transparent;color:#142248}.ds-read[aria-pressed=true]>span{border-color:#142248;background:#142248;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--citron,#d9f65c)}.ds-read:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2345ec);outline-offset:5px;}.ds-read:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-read{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A bright mathematics manual with assertive cobalt fields, citron actions and quiet study pages. Large, compact display type identifies the book and chapters; serif prose supports sustained reading. Chess geometry represents actual positions and legal moves.

The system serves students navigating a bilingual book. Hierarchy comes from type, spacing and meaningful color states. The book title, author, educational text and source diagrams remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Archivo Black headings, Archivo controls, Source Serif study prose
Flat rectangular surfaces and purposeful chess geometry
Equivalent Spanish and English reading experiences

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Keep the current chapter cobalt, the current in-page heading in the soft accent, and completed reading citron; these states convey different information.

rules.name: The Heading Rule
rules.body: Do not append decorative periods to titles or subtitles. Preserve punctuation that belongs to the educational source.

rules.name: The Meaningful Geometry Rule
rules.body: Borders and lines must communicate content, a control boundary, focus or state. Use spacing and type to group headers, indexes, footers and pagination; do not add decorative divider lines.

dos: **Do** use the actual book index, section numbers and legal chess geometry.
**Do** keep study prose at 68ch with the implemented serif roles.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior and equivalent bilingual routes.
**Do** keep borders and diagram lines only when they communicate content or state.
donts: **Don't** add decorative divider lines or periods to headings.
**Don't** introduce shadowed cards or rounded containers into ordinary reading layouts.
**Don't** replace educational text, source diagrams or real chapter labels with invented content.
**Don't** turn the cover's fixed cobalt into the dark theme's softer link accent.
